# Learn Faster to Win

> Learn Faster to Win is the product-management practice of Stefan Wesemann (WMNN Outcomes B.V., Amsterdam) for product leaders at tech-enabled companies. The Learn Faster to Win Loop closes the distance between deciding and knowing in four sectors, Investigate, Curate, Validate and Iterate, with a written verdict on every bet. Three routes, fixed prices: the LFTW Intensive from EUR 25,000 one-off, the LFTW Partnership from EUR 50,000, the LFTW Program from EUR 10,000 per seat. Not a fit: SaaS and AI-native companies, enterprise, companies that do not build, and companies still looking for their first customers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://learnfastertowin.com/): the transition from built to produce to built to learn, the cost of the old game, the Loop, who it fits, the results, the three routes, Stefan.
- [Route check](https://learnfastertowin.com/route): six questions, one lap, a verdict on which route fits.
